items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I don't think I know. Well, that's the way, that's the way he's at, Gross, Paul Gross.

ctx.x: Did you ever know of George's parents or any of the family?

Well, George, when I noticed, I went to his house on Roman, between right, on Roman, between Beville and Abbeville. Of course, I can't say Custom House because he was in Chicago. But I met his wife. And he come home from Chicago and I met his wife over there. There was about the 200 block of Bright Cross from, I don't know if you heard talk about this man, Gross, on Beville and Prayer. No, I don't think I know. Well, that's the way, that's the way he's at, Gross, Paul Gross. Mm-hmm. The Bible and Roman, I want to…
Do you remember, did his father play some instrument or was he in the band?
